Privacy-safe Windows and iOS debug telemetry now records allowlisted subtitle Auto Sync stages and uploads failures automatically when the existing diagnostics opt-in is enabled. Windows Whisper selects the actual non-default playback audio track using mpv instead of silently decoding FFmpeg's first track. Added regression tests. iOS Night Mode native compressor and VideoToolbox are preserved. Oversize signed iOS IPAs are delivered to Telegram as verified GitHub Release links.
